Name: RPG Game with Sebastian
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple mod that makes use of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9550]Dialogue Trees[/url] framework to let you play a simple choice-based adventure game with Sebastian.

To play the game with Sebastian, first exhaust any vanilla dialogue with him, then have him ask you if you want to play by holding down Left Alt and right clicking on him.

This mod requires SMAPI, Content Patcher and Dialogue Trees.

A list of all my mods for Stardew Valley is available at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/895[/url].
